Items served: English muffin sandwich with ham (maybe egg/cheese), about 250 kcal; muffin about 350; yogurt (Brownes peaches & cream, ~150 g) about 130; orange juice (~200 ml) 90; peach segments about 40; toast 2 slices about 160; fried/poached egg 90; avocado about 80; banana about 100; peanut butter 90 (the packet appears to be left unopened or opened; the after photo shows small packets, so it is probably not eaten); butter/jam packets about 30.

Served total: 250+350+130+90+40+160+90+80+100+90+30 = 1410.

Leftover: the yogurt cup has some left, perhaps 25% (about 30 kcal). The banana was eaten (peel only). The muffin was eaten. The sandwich plate is empty. The toast and egg are gone. The peanut butter packet is not visible in the after photo; the small packets there look like jam/honey and butter, opened with the contents used. Count leftover at about 40 kcal, plus a little residue.

Eaten: 1410-40 = 1370.

Macros for the eaten portion: protein about 45 g, carbs about 185 g, fat about 52 g. Check: 45*4=180, 185*4=740, 52*9=468, total 1388. Close enough.
